For our client a international logistics company in Venlo , we are looking for a 
Teamleader warehouse 2 shifts 
At their locations in Venlo, you work in a largely automated environment where technology and data support your team. You focus on what really matters: leading people, improving performance and making the operation better every single day: you're on it. 
As a warehouse team leader, you are the connecting link between the warehouse supervisor and the operation. With your helicopter view, you know exactly what is going on, where bottlenecks arise and when adjustments are needed. You anticipate peak moments, safeguard the workflow and ensure that the right people are in the right place at the right time. You achieve this by: - coordinating and allocating daily activities within inbound and/or outbound; - leading, motivating and coaching your team; - identifying and resolving operational disruptions; - monitoring KPIs such as productivity, quality and lead times; - acting as the first point of contact for colleagues and the warehouse supervisor. Are you a fresh fruit saver, a milk situation solver, or a chips emergency helper? As a delivery driver at Albert Heijn, you’re all of them!  😎  You’ll earn a great salary of € 18,83 per hour after 13 weeks and enjoy a flexible schedule, working 2 to 5 days a week. 🤩 Curious about what else is in store for you? Read on! 👀

What we offer
- Get € 18,83 per hour after 13 weeks!
- Several growth opportunities!
- A chance to get a contract with Albert Heijn!
- Schedule your own shifts via the app!
- Get travel allowance and a pension plan!
- A nice, informal work atmosphere!

Who you are
You are a delivery driver at Albert Heijn who enjoys being on the road delivering groceries. 🚚💙 Physical work is no problem for you. You can easily lift up to 15 kilograms. 💪 You also bring the following:

- A valid B driver’s license 🚗
- Knowledge of Dutch or English
- Your own private transport to reach our location at Ziedewij 36 in Barendrecht

What will you do
Your day starts as a delivery driver at Albert Heijn at the location in Barendrecht. 🏢 Here, you pick up your van keys and route. 🗺️ Time to head to your first destination! At the location, you bring the groceries right to the customer’s doorstep. 🏠 You’ll also check if the payment has been completed. Is everything okay? Then hop back into your van and drive to the next address! Finished delivering all the groceries? Then head back to the location to unload the van and return your equipment.

Ready for more challenges or looking for more interaction with colleagues? You can grow into a buddy role to help train new drivers. 🚀

- Working days: Monday to Sunday, part-time or full-time 📆
- Flexible shifts: 6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM (availability for both shifts is needed)

Where will you work
As a delivery driver at Albert Heijn, you make many customers happy with their groceries every day. Albert Heijn appreciates you! #baanrader 🤩 After thirteen weeks, you’ll receive a pay raise to € 18,83 per hour!

Cha-ching! 💸 Looking for a job that makes your bank account and your schedule happy? As a Warehouse Employee at DPD in Veenendaal, you start with a solid salary of € 14.99. But wait, it gets even better! With good evening, night and weekend allowances, you can earn up to € 22.49 per hour! Whether you want to work full-time or part-time, the choice is yours! Curious what else we offer? Read on!🚀

What we offer
- Top-tier salary of € 14.99 per hour💰
- Allowances up to 50%📈
- Travel allowance🚗
- Get paid every week🗓️
- 50% discount on sending your own parcels📦
- Chance at a fixed contract after just 12 weeks📝

Who you are
We are looking for a powerhouse! You want to be where the action is. As our new Warehouse Employee, you bring the energy, and we bring the work. Furthermore, you check these boxes:

- You are 18+ (safety first!🛡️)
- You are available for at least 2 days a week📅
- You’re ready to rock the afternoon, intermediate, or night shifts🌙
- You speak and understand English or Dutch🗣️
- You live within 50 km of DPD in Veenendaal
- In possession of your own transport for travel during irregular hours🚲

Get ready for a workout! As a Warehouse Employee at DPD, you’ll be unloading trucks filled with packages. It’s the best substitute for your gym subscription, you will get fit while getting paid! 💪 After that, it’s time to hit the sorting belt. By placing every parcel on the belt, you ensure the whole process runs like a well-oiled machine. It’s satisfying, fast-paced, and before you know it, the shift is over and the job is done. Easy-peasy money, right? 😉

- Working days: Monday to Saturday.
- Morning: 03:00 - 07:30 (Monday only)
- Afternoon: 14:00 - 22:30
- Intermediate: 20:00 - 06:30 (Inbetween those hours)
- Night: 22:30 - 07:00

Where will you work
You’ll find us at Kazemat 32 in Veenendaal, the beating heart of DPD. Forget boring offices; here, you work in a high-energy environment where your colleagues become your friends. ?

Are you technically minded and do you enjoy working accurately? Would you like to work on high quality sandwich panels used worldwide in the defence industry? And are you looking for a job with plenty of opportunities to develop yourself? Then this position in Waalwijk could be the perfect fit for you.

You will work in a modern production environment and play an important role in the final stage of the production process. You will have plenty of opportunities to learn how to operate new machines and work with different products.

What are you going to do?
As a Panel Finishing Worker, you make sure the panels are finished to a high standard.

- Remove burrs from aluminium edges and finish the panels neatly
- Apply a waterproof seal
- Saw panels to size
- Carry out quality checks and complete inspection checklists
- Repair minor damage to the products
- Keep your work area clean and tidy
- Work from Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 16:00

What do we offer?
- A salary of €16.33 gross per hour during the first 4 weeks, increasing to €16.72 gross per hour afterwards
- 8.33% holiday allowance
- 25 days of annual leave based on full time employment
- Pension scheme from day 1
- Access to the Adecco Academy for training and development
- Work clothing provided
- A strong possibility of being offered a permanent position and plenty of opportunities to grow within the company

Where will you work?
ou will join a stable and technical manufacturing company that produces high quality sandwich panels. These products are used, among other things, in the defence industry in Europe and America.

What do we ask?
- You work accurately and in a structured way
- You have technical insight and enjoy practical work
- You can read production drawings or are willing to learn
- You can work independently as well as part of a team
- You speak Dutch or English
- You have your own means of transport
- You are willing to learn how to operate new machines and work with different products

 who you are

 what will you do 
As a logistics employee, you work closely with colleagues; for example, you ensure a tidy warehouse. That is the basis for a pleasant workday!
